arguments.code:
async ({ shell: { exec } }) => exec(`set -e
grep -n -B2 -A6 'actions/checkout' .github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml | grep -n 'token' || true
SHA=$(git rev-parse main)
gh api -X DELETE repos/cv/pi-action/git/refs/tags/v2.5.1
TAGSHA=$(gh api repos/cv/pi-action/git/tags -f tag=v2.5.1 -f message=v2.5.1 -f object=$SHA -f type=commit --jq .sha)
gh api repos/cv/pi-action/git/refs -f ref=refs/tags/v2.5.1 -f sha=$TAGSHA --jq .ref
git fetch -q --force origin tag v2.5.1
git cat-file -t v2.5.1; git rev-parse v2.5.1^{commit}`, { timeoutMs: 60000 })
arguments.label: Re-create v2.5.1 tag through the API so release.yml triggers
